title: Prompt ablation: does goal+schema in system prompt complete the click-then-answer sequence?
question: Under the same credential-free, CPU-quantized constraints as EXP-INTEL-37982024058, does supplying the task goal and action schema in the system prompt (parent-style grandparent prompt) convert M-7B-QWEN or M-3B-QWEN from step-0 reveal-click only to full click-then-answer completion?
hypothesis: H1: With goal+schema enriched system prompt (P-TREAT-GOAL-SCHEMA), at least one of M-7B-QWEN or M-3B-QWEN clears the capability bar (task_success_rate >= 0.6 AND parseable_action_rate_step1 >= 0.6 over 5 seeded episodes). H2: Under the underspecified comparator prompt (P-COMP-UNDERSPECIFIED), both models fail to clear the bar (replicating parent).
falsifier: H0: With P-TREAT-GOAL-SCHEMA, neither model clears the bar; comparator cells also reproduce 0/5 success with re-click loop.

P_TREAT_GOAL_SCHEMA.provenance: Derived from grandparent min_webagent.py; adapted ref->selector to match parent schema.
P_TREAT_GOAL_SCHEMA.verbatim: You are a web agent. Reply ONLY with one JSON object per turn, no prose. Actions available: {"action":"click","selector":"<id>"} or {"action":"answer","text":"<code>"}. Click the button to reveal the code, then answer it.

P_COMP_UNDERSPECIFIED.provenance: Byte-identical to parent EXP-INTEL-37982024058 system prompt.
P_COMP_UNDERSPECIFIED.verbatim: You are a web agent. Reply with ONLY a valid JSON action per the schema. No prose, no reasoning, no markdown.

baselines.description: M-7B-QWEN under P-COMP-UNDERSPECIFIED on seeds 42-46; expected to replicate parent 0/5.
Random valid JSON actions, seeded, against served page.

positive_control.description: PC-JSON-CONSTRAINED-DECODING 10/10 per model per prompt condition; PC-ORACLE-EPISODE 5/5 scripted success through same scorer.
positive_control.failure_mode_policy: PC failure -> candidate excluded; PC-ORACLE < 5/5 -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID.

measurement_validity: Same task, harness (run_exp_37982024058.py), grammar, sampling as parent; config-driven only.
Controls run against served page (repaired navigation) - preflight verifies.
Strict JSON schema, mechanical verification via Playwright.
Both prompt conditions for each evaluated candidate; comparator unconditional before decision.
Complete-cell rule: < 5 completed episodes -> measurement failure for candidate.
decision_rule: OUTCOME {SUPPORTS,FALSIFIES,MEASUREMENT_INVALID}. Bar: task_success_rate >= 0.6 AND parseable_action_rate_step1 >= 0.6 over 5 episodes. Preflight: PC-ORACLE 5/5, NC 0/0, B-RANDOM parseable 1.0 with success < 0.6; else MEASUREMENT_INVALID. Order M-7B-QWEN then M-3B-QWEN. For each: A1 PC-JSON under P_treat (10/10 else exclude); A2 5 episodes under P_treat (T,P1,AER); A3 5 under P_comp (C); A4 if clears -> SUPPORTS (attribution PROMPT_ATTRIBUTED if C<0.6, else NOT_PROMPT_ATTRIBUTED if C>=0.6, else UNDETERMINED) and STOP. If none clear after evaluating all, OUTCOME=FALSIFIES, prompt_attribution=UNDETERMINED. Fail-closed on incomplete cells.
product_consequence_positive: Readiness condition (3) for C-LLM-INHERIT satisfied by prompt as driver; enables running frozen four-arm benchmark with verified prompt.
product_consequence_negative: Prompt ablation does not enable full completion under identical constraints; re-scope decision needs to consider ceiling.
expected_information_gain: Directly answers the Director's question and resolves audit VF-01 vs capability ceiling distinction.

decision_rule_reachability.reason: FSM complete: SUPPORTS reachable (oracle proves path exists, treatment changes only prompt); FALSIFIES reachable (parent failure replicable); MEASUREMENT_INVALID reachable via preflight/provisioning/cell completeness; 3/5 threshold attainable; early-stop prevents shadowing.

measurement_prerequisites.reason: Same verified stack as parent: llama.cpp 0.2.90, Playwright 1.63.0, Chrome, CPU-only nproc=4, huggingface resolve-redirect; pinned URLs+sha256 from parent evidence (7B shards, 3B), digest mismatch -> provisioning_failure; harness and repaired controls driver materialized from frozen strings.

baseline_identifiability.reason: Only prompts.system differs between treatment/comparator; all else identical; paired comparator collected unconditionally per candidate; oracle proves 5/5 reachable, parent shows 0/5 on same task - differentiation surface non-zero and neither arm at impossible extremes in a way that collapses identifiability.

control_sensitivity.reason: PC-JSON, PC-ORACLE, NC, B-RANDOM all run against served page via same scorer. Repaired navigation prevents about:blank defect; PC-ORACLE 5/5 proves success path registerable; NC rejects non-parseable; B-RANDOM parseable 1.0, task_success < 0.6 and chance-consistent.

treatment_liveness.reason: Treatment is config string only (no code mutation). PC-ORACLE proves executable behavior via same scorer; harness is audited and config-driven. Product-relevant claim.

freeze_artifacts_bound.reason: All mutable local dependencies pinned: parent harness run_exp_37982024058.py, parent fixture harness_config.json, grandparent min_webagent.py. Per-condition configs and controls driver are EXECUTE-time materializations from frozen strings in prereg (sha256-recorded); no other mutable files.
